tasks.title: Record fork origin, exact commit, branch, license and build prerequisites
tasks.acceptance: Evidence with git commands, repo SHA and MIT notice recorded

tasks.title: Map models, viewmodels, services, UAC/netsh, data paths, scanner and revert
tasks.acceptance: Source map with paths, entry points, call graph and risk notes

tasks.title: Inventory all existing capabilities, supported data formats and compatibility
tasks.acceptance: Baseline preservation checklist signed off

tasks.title: Run non-invasive baseline build/test/static checks where supported
tasks.acceptance: Exact commands/results/limitations; no device configuration

tasks.title: Review risk surface and propose implementation boundaries for Phases 02–09
tasks.acceptance: Audited phase plan, security assumptions and open decisions documented

tasks.title: Prepare the SDK/build environment in a separately authorized checkpoint
tasks.acceptance: Record SDK 8 version, approved install/restore scope and baseline build command/result; no application launch, elevation or network probes

tasks.title: Isolate automated tests from network probes and real adapter enumeration
tasks.acceptance: Review exact safe test set; fake OS/probe boundaries or segregate integration cases; run the isolated baseline and report every exclusion as NOT RUN

tasks.title: Repair and verify the planning validator in a separate tooling task
tasks.acceptance: Support current plan states and task inventory; distinguish GitHub-relative links from filesystem links; retain meaningful checks and demonstrate expected valid/invalid cases

phases.title: Project-scoped JSON profiles

tasks.title: Approve independent versioned project schema and round-trip semantics
tasks.acceptance: Schema reviewed; includes project, profiles, adapter hints, device refs; no secrets

tasks.title: Implement Open Project / Choose Folder / Save As with explicit path
tasks.acceptance: Open/save project JSON from arbitrary user-approved folders; never overwrite silently

tasks.title: Import/export static + DHCP settings including gateway and DNS
tasks.acceptance: Round-trip preserves all specified fields and legacy profile compatibility

tasks.title: Handle schema versions, corrupt files, atomic writes and backups
tasks.acceptance: Clear errors, original file preserved, missing/unknown fields handled per spec

tasks.title: Add unit tests for parse/validate/export, path security and migration
tasks.acceptance: Automated test evidence; existing ProfileRepository unaffected

tasks.title: Review legacy persistence remediation as a separate compatibility change
tasks.acceptance: Document direct-write and backup-failure/delete risks, recovery fixtures and proposed scoped PR; do not change legacy storage without reviewed authorization

phases.entryGate: Phase 01 acceptance and completed preparation checkpoint; explicit Phase 02 authorization

tasks.title: Design device model with name/type/IP/URL/profile reference and group
tasks.acceptance: Explicit identity, profile association and full URL fields

tasks.title: Add per-project Device Web Interfaces UI: create/edit/delete/search/group
tasks.acceptance: Manage multiple device links for one profile without UI redesign

tasks.title: Launch full http/https deep URL with browser default and safe validation
tasks.acceptance: Path, query, fragment preserved; unsafe schemes and URL credentials rejected

tasks.title: Handle HTTP warning, unreachable endpoints and stale profile refs
tasks.acceptance: No hidden credential handling or unsafe TLS suppression

tasks.title: Automated tests for URL parsing/launch abstraction and JSON round-trip
tasks.acceptance: Tests include deep paths/fragments and malformed URLs

tasks.title: Define explicit state machine and adapter-selection gate
tasks.acceptance: No implicit apply; user sees target adapter, requested old/new config

tasks.title: Snapshot pre-change config, apply with UAC, verify actual post-state
tasks.acceptance: Settings re-read; failure clearly reported; best-effort recovery design

tasks.title: Launch browser only after supported network-state verification
tasks.acceptance: Not tied to ping success; no browser launch on failed apply

tasks.title: Add cancellation, error messaging, retry and manual recovery route
tasks.acceptance: All branches documented incl. UAC denied, adapter removed, partial netsh failure

tasks.title: Unit tests for state machine and isolated Windows integration plan
tasks.acceptance: No real NIC changes in CI; manual NIC tests reported separately

tasks.title: Review and harden the elevated request boundary for the new apply flow
tasks.acceptance: Bind typed validated request to stable NIC identity, recheck after UAC, review request/result paths and tampering, and cover rejection paths without elevation

tasks.title: Review legacy history and revert limitations separately
tasks.acceptance: Define backward-compatible handling of missing DNS/policy/routes/additional-address snapshots; scope any legacy repair separately and never invent recoverable state

tasks.title: Specify explicit 169.254/16 mode, selection and address constraints
tasks.acceptance: No gateway; previous config captured; DHCP mode not confused with manual link-local

tasks.title: Add conflict check and controlled address choice/assignment
tasks.acceptance: Avoid claimed conflict-free guarantee from ping alone; use Windows APIs where justified

tasks.title: Add restore/return-to-DHCP action and consistent UI states
tasks.acceptance: Existing profile semantics and IPv6 preserved

tasks.title: Test on isolated adapter and cover failures in unit tests
tasks.acceptance: Test evidence with no live production network scanning

tasks.title: Represent link-local state without hiding the selected address
tasks.acceptance: Account for current APIPA filtering in GetAdapters; distinguish automatic APIPA from manual link-local and verify display/snapshot/restore with fixtures

tasks.title: Define service-discovery scope, interface binding and listener lifecycle
tasks.acceptance: Explicit start/stop; does not leak onto unintended interface

tasks.title: Implement mDNS listener/discovery without copying AV Toolbag source
tasks.acceptance: Source provenance clean; bounded CPU/memory and packet parsing

tasks.title: Display service type, hostname, IP, port, TTL; optional add-to-device
tasks.acceptance: Entries may be incomplete; no automatic config or trust of unverified hostnames

tasks.title: Add safe export/filter, timeouts and negative tests
tasks.acceptance: CSV injection mitigated, invalid packets handled; tests via fixtures

tasks.title: Map physical, USB, Wi-Fi, virtual and Hyper-V adapters without false binding
tasks.acceptance: Unambiguous selection and stable hints; never choose adapter silently

tasks.title: Add diagnostics: IPv4/DHCP/DNS/gateway/route/link status
tasks.acceptance: Clearly distinguish interface-derived vs probe-derived status

tasks.title: Add opt-in Hyper-V uplink filtering and persistence
tasks.acceptance: Adapter hiding affects UI only, never silently disables interfaces

tasks.title: Extend tests for enumeration/failures/performance
tasks.acceptance: Virtual and unplugged adapters included in fixtures; existing behavior preserved

tasks.title: Threat-model and specify isolated service boundaries BEFORE implementation
tasks.acceptance: Written approval checkpoint for binding, relay, conflicts, firewall, cleanup

tasks.title: Design pool, lease, router/DNS/NTP options with safe validation
tasks.acceptance: Pool excludes host/router/reserved and validates subnet/leases

tasks.title: Implement explicit start/stop, adapter binding, visibility and audit logs
tasks.acceptance: No auto-start; active interface prominent; service cannot silently move NICs

tasks.title: Detect existing DHCP where feasible; reliable cleanup of sockets/firewall
tasks.acceptance: Abort or warn for suspicious network; crash recovery and stop behavior tested

tasks.title: Prove behavior only on isolated lab network with explicit permission
tasks.acceptance: Documented packet captures/leasing and negative tests; never use production LAN

tasks.title: Run full unit, static-analysis and Windows build regression suite
tasks.acceptance: Commands, OS/build, exact commit and results documented

tasks.title: Run isolated adapter tests across DHCP/static/gateway/DNS/revert/link-local
tasks.acceptance: Pass/fail matrix; never claim unperformed live tests passed

tasks.title: Verify JSON compatibility, web deep-links, URL security, profiles + history
tasks.acceptance: Import/export round-trip and previous version fixtures covered

tasks.title: Verify mDNS, Hyper-V diagnostics and DHCP isolated-network safety
tasks.acceptance: DHCP release blocked if service safety evidence absent

tasks.title: Prepare changelog, MIT notices, tagged release and reproducible artifacts
